note: PROPOSED, waiting on Josh's approval. CC-BY or CC0 only. The level's rock walls, water, drops and the chimney shaft are drawn by the renderer, and the prop kit already has the station's tunnel and platform lamps (caged bulkhead, caged hanging light, mounted fluorescent, fluorescent batten, bare bulb), work lights on tripods, a hanging lantern, rubble, cable drums, crates, drums and signs drawn as props. This is what a flooded subway platform broken through into caves is missing: the dead train, track, turnstiles, benches, a tunnel signal, cave formations and boulders, a rope bridge, THE CLIMBING ROPE, the survey team's lamps, the manhole cover and streetlight at the top of THE CHIMNEY, two options for THE BURROWER, and twelve photographed surfaces. Extra fields (url, zone, shelf, sizeMB) are for the contact sheet; fetch.mjs ignores them. Contact sheet: docs/backrooms/level8-assets.md. node scripts/assets/fetch.mjs scripts/assets/level8.json --dry

the station walls: derelict, broken blue-and-white subway tiles
chipped, stained white rectangular subway tile — the stair and turnstile hall
the platform: weathered, scuffed concrete
the track bed: grey ballast between the rails, under the flood
the Caverns' main wall: rough, cracked grey rock face
pale, striated rock — limestone bedding for the biggest chambers
wet limestone: smooth, wet grey flowstone by the river and under drips
the Deep: bare, discoloured, close rock for the narrow passages
dark near-black cave rock for the chasm walls
the cave floor: broken rock and grit
wet pebbles and silt along the underground river
the crawlspaces' floor: wet mud and stones
